observations.contract: Host-style float contract and selected hooks
observations.trace: The host_float module documents a runtime-zero bit fence, dependence on fused residuals, possible device subnormal flushing and a quarter-turn reduction range of a few thousand radians. Its full source provides arithmetic helpers and double-float series. Selected metal WGSL prepends PARAMS_ZERO_HOOK and the library; inspected metal sample and cut dispatch source insert ZERO_FIELD as0. The full test source describes deterministic sampled comparisons and zero-hook compilation rejection.
observations.remaining: Source and unexecuted test bodies are not proof of compiler behavior, numerical correctness on any GPU, actual FMA, or all callers. Preserve finite/subnormal and range qualifications; tests, shaders and device operations were not run.

observations.contract: Zero base with negative host_pow exponent
observations.trace: The module describes host_pow as taking a positive base or zero; the function returns1 for exponent0 or base1, then returns0 for any base that is not positive. Therefore the source branch for an otherwise ordinary symbolic input base0 and exponent-1 chooses0, while its explanatory comment compares zero with a positive exponent only. The checked-in test generator samples pow bases in [0.01,4), so that source test does not cover zero. On the selected breastplate path, DeviceBreastplate::record validates the design; profile fullness must be 350..1000 permille, design_words passes that positive value, and the front shape and fit expressions use 2/fullness as the exponent.
observations.remaining: This is an unresolved supported-domain/host-equivalence question for zero with negative exponent, not an observed shader or claim that the selected validated breastplate produces it. Exact host special-value rules, external including kernels, negative/NaN exponents and any intended deliberate deviation remain open. No power, float arithmetic, shader, compiler, GPU or test ran.

Their sampled domains, zero hook, and test-specific outputs are visible as source.
observations.remaining: No test was run and no pass result is inferred. Sine reduction, FMA and subnormal behavior remain independently qualified. Complete all native compiler and resource/ABI contracts before any later validation.
